stories.title: Guardians Complete Stunning Comeback — Beat White Sox in Game 5, Advance to ALCS
stories.angle: Ramirez was the offensive engine despite hamate surgery. The Guardians were massive underdogs after falling 0-2. Now they face a Rays team that swept the Yankees.

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
The Cleveland Guardians were down 0-2 to the White Sox.

They won three straight games to advance to the ALCS.

The last team to pull off a 0-2 comeback in a best-of-5 was the 2017 Yankees — against Cleveland. October is wild. #ForTheLand

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
José Ramírez played the ALDS on a surgically repaired hamate bone.

He hit a HR and drove in 3 in Game 4. He was everywhere in this series.

Cleveland is going back to the ALCS. J-Ram made sure of it. #ForTheLand #MLB

stories.title: White Sox Season Ends — The Most Surprising ALDS Run in Recent Memory
stories.angle: The White Sox went 81-81, the first non-winning team to clinch a playoff berth in MLB history. They beat the Astros in Wild Card, went up 2-0 on Cleveland. Ultimately fell short, but changed what we thought was possible in one offseason.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
The White Sox season is over.

They were the first team in MLB history to follow back-to-back 100-loss seasons with a playoff berth. They beat the Astros. They led Cleveland 2-0 in the ALDS.

That was not supposed to happen. Respect the run. #WhiteSox
